D/ IMP CONSTANTINVS P F AVG ; R/ PRINCIPI IV-VENTVTIS

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Principi Iuventutis issue of 307, Reece period 15, London mint, RIC VI, p. 132, no. 111. Obverse description: bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTANTINVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Youth standing facing with head left holding a standard either side. Reverse inscription: PRINCIPI IV-VENTVTIS. In exergue: PLN.
